messages:
nina: Quick heads-upI'm refreshing the Quickstart/onboarding page today. Scope: single-file hello-world (JS + Python), browser PKCE auth, server API-key example, tiny Docker local dev, and a minimal GH Actions first-deploy. I'll open a draft PR later. cc @omar @kyle

omar: Love it. Keep examples copy-paste runnable with exact install commands. Also add a curl token check for debugging 401s.

kyle: +1 on PKCE for browser. For server example show simple rotation note and env var names (REDWOOD_HOST, REDWOOD_API_KEY).

nina: Plan: JS (vanilla, <=20 lines), Python (FastAPI tiny example), curl example, Dockerfile + docker-compose. Will include PKCE redirect example using http://localhost:5173/auth/callback.

omar: Please standardize on `Client` import from `@redwood/inference-js` and `redwood_inference.Client` in Python. Bump package examples to v0.11.

kyle: Add a Troubleshooting accordion: 401 -> check key/scopes, CORS -> add origin in console, redirect mismatch -> exact-URI match. One-liners ok.

docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR #478 (branch: docs/qs-refresh-478).

preview-bot: Staging preview available: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/478 (expires in 6 days).

omar: I'll run the examples locally and push any tiny fixes.

nina: Draft PR will be opened tonight. ETA: move out of draft by tomorrow morning. Thanks! :rocket:
